display.purpose: Wristband headline when the screen is about us (Er tur!, Ni är med!). Player world.

headline.purpose: Wristband headline about another team (<Lags> tur, <Lag> vann). Player world.

stub-year.purpose: The year on every ticket stub, and the ? on an open slot. The only display element on a stub.

title.purpose: Uppercase section heads on the night ground (Er tidslinje, Lag (n)).

body.purpose: Hints and running text in the player world; hint line at 0.95rem in Night Muted.

body-strong.purpose: Song titles on stubs; team names on bands at 0.9rem.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked sub-line under the wristband headline (team name).

small.purpose: Artist line on a stub, footer (0.8rem), offline tag (0.7rem bold).

host-body.purpose: Incumbent host console text and buttons (system UI stack).

shadows.name: snap-inset
shadows.purpose: The only depth in the player world: turns the wristband's paper snap into a pressed disc.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Shared easing for the wristband wipe, the slot tear-open, and the host pop-in.

motion.name: band-in
motion.purpose: Wristband wipes in left to right whenever its owner or headline changes.

motion.name: tear-open
motion.value: scaleY(0.4), opacity 0, min-height 0 to rest over 0.35s
motion.purpose: The chosen slot grows open into the lime ? stub.

motion.name: host-pop
motion.purpose: Incumbent host console: result panel entry.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation is removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: column
breakpoints.purpose: Max content width for both worlds; phones only, no other breakpoints.

breakpoints.name: band-grid
breakpoints.purpose: Team band grid switches from 2 to 3 columns at 9 or more teams (count-based, not width-based).

components.name: Lock Button
components.description: The docked primary action on a team's turn; acid lime because it is pressable.
components.css: .ds-lock { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; min-height:64px; border:none; border-radius:10px; background:#d7ff3d; color:#17122e; font-family:'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size:2rem; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-lock:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #d7ff3d; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-lock:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Lock Button Disabled
components.description: Before a slot is chosen: fully opaque, night fill, dashed perforation edge, muted prompt.
components.css: .ds-lock-off { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; min-height:64px; border:2px dashed rgb(241 238 251 / 0.3); border-radius:10px; background:#221a42; color:#b9b3d6; font-family:'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Wristband
components.description: Full-bleed team-colour header naming whose screen it is, with a paper snap; wipes in on change.
components.css: .ds-wristband { position:relative; padding:28px 72px 18px 20px; background:#2e2556; color:#f1eefb; animation:ds-band-in .5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-wristband::after { content:''; position:absolute; right:22px; bottom:20px; width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:50%; background:#f4f5f8; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 6px rgb(23 18 46 / 0.12); } .ds-wb-big { margin:0; font-family:'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size:clamp(3.4rem,17vw,4.4rem); font-weight:900; line-height:0.85; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-wb-sub { margin-top:8px; font-family:Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:0.95rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; opacity:0.92; } @keyframes ds-band-in { from { clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0); } to { clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0); } }

components.name: Team Band
components.description: A team as a solid colour pill with a paper count disc; tap to show its timeline. Shown, offline and winner states.
components.css: .ds-band { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:4px; min-height:44px; padding:0 4px 0 10px; border:none; border-radius:22px; font-family:Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1.1; text-align:left; outline:2px solid transparent; outline-offset:2px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-band.ds-shown { outline-color:#f1eefb; } .ds-band:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #d7ff3d; } .ds-band-name { min-width:0; } .ds-count { display:grid; place-items:center; min-width:28px; height:28px; padding:0 5px; border-radius:14px; background:#f4f5f8; color:#17122e; font-family:'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:900; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-off { display:table; margin-top:2px; padding:1px 6px; border-radius:4px; background:#17122e; color:#f4f5f8; font-size:0.7rem; font-weight:700; }

components.name: Ticket Stub
components.description: A song as a notched paper ticket: display-face year, dashed tear line, title and artist.
components.css: .ds-stub { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; min-height:72px; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:6px; background:#f4f5f8; color:#17122e; font-family:Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; -webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle 9px at 0 50%, transparent 98%, #000) left / 51% 100% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle 9px at 100% 50%, transparent 98%, #000) right / 51% 100% no-repeat; mask:radial-gradient(circle 9px at 0 50%, transparent 98%, #000) left / 51% 100% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle 9px at 100% 50%, transparent 98%, #000) right / 51% 100% no-repeat; } .ds-year { flex:none; width:3.1ch; font-family:'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size:2.5rem; font-weight:900; line-height:1; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-stub-text { display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding-left:14px; border-left:2px dashed #c9cbd6; line-height:1.25; } .ds-artist { color:#565072; font-size:0.85rem; }

components.name: Won Stub
components.description: The card just won stays lime until the next turn.
components.css: .ds-stub-won { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; min-height:72px; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:6px; background:#d7ff3d; color:#17122e; font-family:Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; -webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle 9px at 0 50%, transparent 98%, #000) left / 51% 100% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle 9px at 100% 50%, transparent 98%, #000) right / 51% 100% no-repeat; mask:radial-gradient(circle 9px at 0 50%, transparent 98%, #000) left / 51% 100% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle 9px at 100% 50%, transparent 98%, #000) right / 51% 100% no-repeat; } .ds-year { width:3.1ch; font-family:'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size:2.5rem; font-weight:900; line-height:1; } .ds-stub-text { display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding-left:14px; border-left:2px dashed rgb(23 18 46 / 0.3); }

components.name: Perforation Slot
components.description: Perforations between stubs are the slots; tapping one tears the strip open into a lime ? stub.
components.css: .ds-perf { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:0 10px; border:none; border-radius:6px; background:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-perf::before, .ds-perf::after { content:''; flex:1; border-top:2px dashed rgb(241 238 251 / 0.3); } .ds-plus { position:relative; flex:none; width:26px; height:26px; border:2px solid rgb(241 238 251 / 0.55); border-radius:50%; } .ds-plus::before, .ds-plus::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; margin:auto; width:10px; height:2px; background:#f1eefb; } .ds-plus::after { transform:rotate(90deg); } .ds-perf:hover .ds-plus { border-color:#d7ff3d; } .ds-perf:focus-visible, .ds-open:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #d7ff3d; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-open { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; width:100%; min-height:72px; margin:4px 0; padding:8px 16px; border:3px dashed #d7ff3d; border-radius:6px; background:rgb(215 255 61 / 0.1); color:#d7ff3d; font-family:Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight:700; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-q { width:3.1ch; font-family:'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size:2.5rem; font-weight:900; line-height:1; } .ds-open-text { padding-left:14px; border-left:2px dashed rgb(215 255 61 / 0.4); }

components.name: Verdict Tag
components.description: Small ink tag announcing the game-ending card.
components.css: .ds-verdict { display:inline-block; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:4px; background:#17122e; color:#f4f5f8; font-family:'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size:1.1rem; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Host Primary Button (incumbent)
components.description: Host and entry screens only: the one green primary action.
components.css: .ds-host-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:0 1.1rem; border:1px solid #22c55e; border-radius:14px; background:#22c55e; color:#052e16; font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; } .ds-host-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-host-primary:disabled { opacity:0.45; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.description: Host and entry screens only: slate field, e.g. the join code.
components.css: .ds-host-input { width:100%; min-height:48px; padding:0 0.9rem; border:1px solid #334155; border-radius:14px; background:#0f172a; color:#f8fafc; font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; font-size:1.05rem; } .ds-host-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
The game runs in two visual worlds, and which one applies is decided by route. **The team's phone (`/play/:code`) is Festivalbiljetten**: a night-field indigo ground, every song a thermal-white festival ticket stub dated by its year, every team a flat wristband of its own colour, and one acid lime reserved for the thing you press. It is built to be read in a one-second glance across a loud room: whose band owns the top of the screen, every team's count, our own stub strip, the slot we picked. Everything in this world is scoped under the `.fest` wrapper (`src/play.css`), so none of it leaks onto the host.

**The host's phone and the entry screens (`/`, `/host`, `/host/:code`, `/host/songs`, `/join/:code`, and the plain fallback screens inside Play such as "Spelet finns inte längre" and "Spelet är fullt") keep the incumbent dark-slate console** from `src/index.css`: slate surfaces, system-ui type, a single green primary, 14px rounding throughout. It is the original POC look and is documented here as it stands; it has not been redesigned and this file does not propose one. New player-surface work extends Festivalbiljetten; new host work extends the slate console until a deliberate host redesign replaces it.

Festivalbiljetten is flat print, not texture: bands are solid team colour, the snap on the wristband is a plain paper disc, tickets are flat paper with notched edges and a dashed tear line. Its drama comes from scale (a condensed 900-weight display face at up to 4.4rem) and from the one lime colour, not from effects.
keyCharacteristics: Two route-scoped worlds: Festivalbiljetten for teams, dark-slate console for the host and entry screens.
Night indigo ground, thermal-white ticket paper, ink-indigo print.
Team colour appears only as solid wristband fill, full-bleed or as a pill.
Acid lime marks what can be pressed, plus the one stub just won.
Big Shoulders Display for years, banners and the lock button; Archivo for everything you read.
Perforations between stubs are the placement slots.

rules.name: The Pressable Lime Rule
rules.body: Acid lime goes on things a team can press (lock, open slot, focus, hover) and on the single just-won stub. Never on decoration, headings, or text on the night ground outside the open slot.

rules.name: The Fabric Rule
rules.body: Team colour is a fill, never a text colour or a border on night. A team is identified by a solid band of its colour with contrast-chosen text on it.

rules.name: The Scoped World Rule
rules.body: Festivalbiljetten tokens live under `.fest` and the slate tokens live on `:root`. Do not mix them: no slate green or blue focus ring on a player screen, no indigo or lime on a host screen.

rules.name: The One Headline per Stub Rule
rules.body: On a stub only the year is set in the display face. Title and artist are Archivo, and nothing else on the stub competes with the year.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Years and card counts use tabular figures so columns of stubs and band counts align.

rules.name: The Whole Room at Once Rule
rules.body: All teams fit on screen in the band grid; team names clamp to two lines instead of truncating to one or scrolling sideways.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A surface is distinguished by its paper or fabric colour, never by a cast shadow.

dos: **Do** scope every player-world style under the `.fest` wrapper and set the browser theme colour to Night while it is mounted.
**Do** give every team its own solid band of colour, with text chosen by the contrast helper.
**Do** keep every stub the same height (72px minimum) and let only the year speak in the display face.
**Do** keep all teams visible in the band grid: 2 columns up to 8 teams, 3 above.
**Do** keep the disabled lock fully opaque and readable; signal "not yet" with the dashed edge and muted prompt.
**Do** keep host and entry screens on the slate console tokens until a deliberate host redesign.
donts: **Don't** use Acid Lime on anything that cannot be pressed, except the one just-won stub.
**Don't** set team colours as text or outlines on the night ground.
**Don't** show teams in a sideways-scrolling tab row on the player screen; the band grid replaced it.
**Don't** truncate team names to one line; clamp to two.
**Don't** add drop shadows; the player world is flat print.
**Don't** bring slate green, slate blue focus rings or system-ui type into a `.fest` screen, or lime and indigo into a host screen.
